headword: {専業主夫|せんぎょうしゅふ}

definitions.explanation: A man who does not work outside the home and instead takes care of household duties and childcare full-time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{専業主夫|せんぎょうしゅふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{妻|つま}→妻：01005_tsuma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{転勤|てんきん}→転勤：04555_tenkin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦きっかけ→きっかけ：10309_kikkake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{専業主夫|せんぎょうしゅふ}になった。
examples.english: I became a stay-at-home dad after my wife's job transfer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{専業主夫|せんぎょうしゅふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{増|ふ}えて→増える：01183_fueru⟧きた⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{社会的|しゃかいてき}→社会的：04791_shakaiteki⟧な⟦{理解|りかい}→理解：03674_rikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{言|い}えない→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: More men are choosing to be stay-at-home dads recently, but social understanding is still not enough.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{専業|せんぎょう}→専業：15394_sengyou⟧ (full-time, exclusive occupation) + {主夫|しゅふ} (househusband). A relatively modern term that mirrors ⟦{専業主婦|せんぎょうしゅふ}→専業主婦：16565_sengyoushufu⟧ (full-time housewife). The kanji {夫|ふ} (husband) distinguishes it from {婦|ふ} (wife). Both words are read せんぎょうしゅふ, so the kanji is needed to tell them apart.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {専業主夫|せんぎょうしゅふ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become a stay-at-home dad
- {専業主夫|せんぎょうしゅふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧: to be a stay-at-home dad
- {専業主夫|せんぎょうしゅふ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: life as a househusband

CULTURAL NOTE:
While still uncommon in Japan, the number of {専業主夫|せんぎょうしゅふ} has been gradually increasing. The concept has gained visibility through TV dramas and media coverage, though men in this role may still face social stigma.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{専業主婦|せんぎょうしゅふ}→専業主婦：16565_sengyoushufu⟧: full-time housewife — the female equivalent
- {主夫|しゅふ}: househusband — without ⟦{専業|せんぎょう}→専業：15394_sengyou⟧, may include part-time workers
- ⟦イクメン→イクメン：06723_ikumen⟧: active father, hands-on dad — a father who is involved in childcare but may still work
